paraphrase: An app where users post content or interact socially must filter objectionable material, let users report content and get a timely response, let users block abusers, and publish contact details. Apps that become mostly pornographic, random chat, hot-or-not voting, threats or bullying are removed. Creator-content apps must let users identify content above the app's age rating and gate it by age.
